mapper.sql: id, order_no, item_id, item_title, item_image_url, amount, buyer_username, buyer_name, seller_name, seller_contact, delivery_method, trade_location, payment_method, contact, note, status, created_at, paid_at, completed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = '已付款', paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} AND status = '待付款'
UPDATE orders SET status = '已取消' WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} AND status = '待付款'
UPDATE orders SET status = '已完成', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} AND status = '已付款'
